newsitem.title: USA: Fountain Powerboat CEO sees Q4 profits.
newsitem.headline: Fountain Powerboat CEO sees Q4 profits.

text.p: Fountain Powerboat Industries Inc's Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, R.M. Fountain, said Wednesday he expects the company will be solidly profitable and will enjoy record sales for the fourth quarter and fiscal year.

Fountain said that the loss in the third quarter of 1997 ended March 31 was due largely to the substantial startup and research and development expenses incurred by the company's new subsidiary, Fountain Power Inc.
Net loss for the for the third quarter of 1997 was $418,171 as compared to a net profit in the third quarter of 1996 of $503,023.
The new subsidiary was established to develop high performance propulsion systems for the company's new line of sport boats.

Fountain added that the company is currently negotiating with two major engine and drive manufacturers to form a strategic alliance with one of them. He concluded that a strategic alliance with an engine and drive manufacturer "could have a very significant beneficial impact upon the company and its operations."
